about: Zechariah saw visions from God and told about a gentle King who would come riding on a donkey.

pages.title: Not by Might
pages.scene: A golden lampstand with two olive trees
pages.text: The leader Zerubbabel had a big job, rebuilding the temple. God told him through Zechariah, "Not by strength or power, but by my Spirit." Small beginnings matter to God!
pages.lesson: God's Spirit helps us do big jobs.

pages.title: Here Comes Your King
pages.scene: A king riding on a little donkey
pages.text: Zechariah said, "Shout for joy! Your King is coming! He is good and gentle, riding on a donkey." Hundreds of years later, Jesus rode into Jerusalem on a donkey, just like Zechariah said.
